{
  "design": {
    "theme": "chalk",
    "picture_style": "illustration"
  },
  "flow": [
    {"slide":1,"does":"Recall division and equal sharing","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[]},
    {"slide":2,"does":"Introduce the lesson objectives","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[]},
    {"slide":3,"does":"Model finding a unit fraction","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"24 counters shared into four equal groups"},"teaches":[1]},
    {"slide":4,"does":"Check unit fractions with a matched example","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"28 counters shared into four equal groups"},"teaches":[1]},
    {"slide":5,"does":"Model finding a non-unit fraction","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"A bar of 35 split into five equal parts, with three selected"},"teaches":[2]},
    {"slide":6,"does":"Check non-unit fractions with a matched example","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"A bar of 40 split into five equal parts, with three selected"},"teaches":[2]},
    {"slide":7,"does":"Correct confusion between numerator and denominator","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"Two selected parts of a 24 bar split into three equal parts"},"teaches":[1,2]},
    {"slide":8,"does":"Check which operation comes first","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[2]},
    {"slide":9,"does":"Model a one-step money problem","look_at":{"kind":"diagram","shows":"£40 split into eight equal parts, with three selected"},"teaches":[3]},
    {"slide":10,"does":"Check a matched money problem","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[3]},
    {"slide":11,"does":"Apply fractions to quantities and measures","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[1,2,3]},
    {"slide":12,"does":"Apply and justify in a new context","look_at":{"kind":"none","shows":null},"teaches":[2,3]}
  ],
  "title": {
    "template":"title",
    "heading":"Fractions of amounts",
    "lead":"Recall: 24 ÷ 4 = ? What does sharing equally mean?",
    "picture":null
  },
  "slides": [
    {
      "template":"visual-text",
      "heading":"Find ¼ of 24",
      "lead":"The denominator tells us how many equal groups to make.",
      "points":[
        "24 ÷ 4 = 6",
        "One group is ¼ of 24, so the answer is 6."
      ],
      "figure":{
        "kind":"equal-groups",
        "shows":"24 counters shared equally into four groups",
        "alt":"Four rings each contain six counters.",
        "title":null,
        "total":24,
        "groups":4,
        "layout":"rings",
        "show_count":"each",
        "unknown":false
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"big-visual",
      "heading":"Find ¼ of 28",
      "lead":"Write the division and the answer.",
      "figure":{
        "kind":"equal-groups",
        "shows":"28 counters shared into four equal groups for pupils to count",
        "alt":"28 counters are arranged in four equal rings.",
        "title":null,
        "total":28,
        "groups":4,
        "layout":"rings",
        "show_count":"none",
        "unknown":true
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"visual-text",
      "heading":"Find ⅗ of 35",
      "lead":"Divide into five equal parts. Take three of those parts.",
      "points":[
        "35 ÷ 5 = 7",
        "7 × 3 = 21, so ⅗ of 35 is 21."
      ],
      "figure":{
        "kind":"bar-model",
        "shows":"35 split into five equal parts with three shaded",
        "alt":"A bar totals 35 and has five parts of seven, with three shaded.",
        "title":null,
        "bars":[{"label":null,"whole":35,"parts":5,"values":null,"shaded":3,"unknown":"none","unit":null}],
        "combined":false
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"big-visual",
      "heading":"Find ⅗ of 40",
      "lead":"Write both calculations and the answer.",
      "figure":{
        "kind":"bar-model",
        "shows":"40 split into five equal parts with three shaded; each part is unknown",
        "alt":"A bar totals 40 and is split into five equal parts, with three shaded and part values unknown.",
        "title":null,
        "bars":[{"label":null,"whole":40,"parts":5,"values":null,"shaded":3,"unknown":"each","unit":null}],
        "combined":false
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"visual-text",
      "heading":"Which number do we divide by?",
      "lead":"For ⅔ of 24, dividing by 2 makes halves, not thirds.",
      "points":[
        "Denominator 3: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.",
        "Numerator 2: 8 × 2 = 16."
      ],
      "figure":{
        "kind":"bar-model",
        "shows":"24 split into thirds with two thirds shaded",
        "alt":"A bar totals 24 and has three parts of eight, with two shaded.",
        "title":null,
        "bars":[{"label":null,"whole":24,"parts":3,"values":null,"shaded":2,"unknown":"none","unit":null}],
        "combined":false
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"hinge",
      "heading":"Choose the calculation",
      "stem":"Which finds ¾ of 20?",
      "options":["20 ÷ 3 × 4","20 ÷ 4 × 3","20 ÷ 4","20 × 3"],
      "correct":2
    },
    {
      "template":"visual-text",
      "heading":"A money problem",
      "lead":"Amir has £40. He spends ⅜ of it. How much does he spend?",
      "points":[
        "£40 ÷ 8 = £5 for one eighth.",
        "£5 × 3 = £15 spent."
      ],
      "figure":{
        "kind":"bar-model",
        "shows":"£40 split into eight equal parts with three selected as spending",
        "alt":"A £40 bar has eight parts of £5, with three shaded.",
        "title":null,
        "bars":[{"label":null,"whole":40,"parts":8,"values":null,"shaded":3,"unknown":"none","unit":"£"}],
        "combined":false
      }
    },
    {
      "template":"practice",
      "heading":"Try a money problem",
      "questions":[
        "Leila has £56. She spends ⅜ of it. How much does she spend?"
      ],
      "instruction":"Write your calculations. Include the unit in your answer.",
      "picture":null
    },
    {
      "template":"practice",
      "heading":"Use fractions in everyday problems",
      "questions":[
        "A box holds 36 pencils. ¼ are blue. How many are blue?",
        "A ribbon is 45 cm long. Eva cuts off ⅖ of it. How many centimetres does she cut off?",
        "A jug holds 800 ml of juice. Tom pours out ⅜ of it. How many millilitres does he pour out?"
      ],
      "instruction":"Solve each problem. Show your working and include units.",
      "picture":null
    },
    {
      "template":"practice",
      "heading":"Plan the school garden",
      "questions":[
        "A garden has 48 planting spaces. ⅝ will hold flowers. How many spaces will hold flowers?",
        "A £72 budget has ⅔ set aside for seeds. How much money is set aside?",
        "Stretch: Jo says ⅝ of 48 equals ¾ of 40. Is Jo right? Prove it with calculations."
      ],
      "instruction":"Solve the problems. Explain how you know your answers are sensible.",
      "picture":null
    }
  ]
}
